source: 3_reproduction/L12/ (light leaf: single-orbital Slater-Koster tight-binding model of an 8-orbital pair-doped chain; sktb_quasi.py builds it, result.json records the guard values). The Gamma eigenvalues were recomputed from the leaf construction and independently cross-checked. The base-set path maximum is also recorded at guards.G8_figure_match.branch_observables.ideal.max_split_Lp_eV in result.json (the larger ideal branch maximum), and independently checked on the prescribed 401-point path (see notes.md).

eig_up_gamma_base_eV.rule: per component within +/-10% (each of the 8 up-spin eigenvalues at Gamma, base set, ascending)

gamma_split_base_eV.rule: symmetry-forced zero: absolute band. Correct build gives ~2e-15 eV; the smallest non-degenerate split among the perturbed sets is 0.024 eV, far outside the band.
